basics.name: Kyle M. Anderson
basics.summary: Technical lead and software developer with experience advancing a tax-integration platform, coordinating development projects, and supporting client implementations. Background includes platform modernization, asynchronous performance improvements, AWS migration, and translating business requirements into technical solutions.

work.name: DSTax Technologies
work.summary: Technical lead, lead developer, and project manager for a tax-integration platform, with responsibilities across development, client support, implementation, and documentation.
highlights: Led the transition from Version 1 to Version 2 of the tax-integration platform, broadening tax-provider and financial-platform support and improving UI/UX.
Optimized asynchronous operations to improve performance and throughput.
Migrated production workloads from DigitalOcean to AWS.
Developed integrations between financial platforms and tax providers, supporting platforms including Acumatica, Sage Intacct, Thomson Reuters, and Vertex.
Managed internal development projects and client-coordinated work, communicating integration updates, project status, and responses to questions and requests.
Supported end-to-end integration implementations through requirements gathering, setup, troubleshooting, and go-live support.
Created and maintained client guides and knowledge-base articles.

work.name: Colectivo Coffee Roasters
highlights: Partnered with the IT department to install and troubleshoot new point-of-sale nodes.
Fulfilled orders for more than 1000 restaurant and store clients and updated invoices for inventory changes.

work.name: Komatsu Mining Corp. (Joy Global)
highlights: Evaluated, selected, and implemented a global mapping platform that provided facility information to employees and customers.
Initiated web automations that reduced manual database-maintenance work.
Managed SharePoint sites and data and designed data-input forms to improve accessibility, reduce errors, and promote cross-department information sharing.
